name: mizan-mcp
description: Expose the Mizan eval engine to agents and MCP clients as callable tools via the `mizan mcp` server. Registers a local stdio MCP server (`mizan mcp stdio`) advertising four tools — mizan_list_metrics, mizan_get_metric (read-only), mizan_eval_run, and mizan_eval_pairwise — plus an agent-in-the-loop eval skill. Use when an agent should discover a judge and run an evaluation over MCP rather than shelling out to the CLI.
